name: Llama {GAME}ni
description:
It is known that the roots of the founders of this faction are in Peru. According to rumors, this racing team was named after the ancestral domestic llama. It was distinguished by grace, intelligence and stubbornness.
When competing with members of this team, remember that it is not worth it to tease and anger them. After all, the amulet in the form of a multi-colored llama installed in each tank car not only brings good luck and success to the owners, but also mirrors all the attacks of ill-wishers. Pride and perseverance will undoubtedly lead Llama {GAME}ni straight to victory!
See also: Paints
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on february 24th, 2023.
Llama {GAME}ni could have been obtained during The «Rally Tankcar» Event.
